parameters.jsCode: const parseRec=(v)=>{if(typeof v==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(v);}catch(e){return null;}} return (v&&typeof v==='object')?v:null;}; const j=$input.first().json; const rows=[]; for(const k of Object.keys(j||{})){ if(k.indexOf('remind:')!==0) continue; const rec=parseRec(j[k]); if(!rec||!rec.appointmentISO) continue; const rAt=Number(rec.remindedAt)||null; const confAt=Number(rec.confirmedAt)||null; const status=(!rAt)?'scheduled':((confAt!==null&&rAt!==null&&confAt>rAt)?'confirmed':'awaiting_reply'); rows.push({patient:rec.patientName||'patient',service:rec.serviceName||rec.service||'visit',appointmentISO:rec.appointmentISO,remindedAt:rAt,confirmedAt:confAt,status:status}); } rows.sort((a,b)=>String(b.appointmentISO).localeCompare(String(a.appointmentISO))); return [{json:{total:rows.length,items:rows.slice(0,50)}}];
